title: com.get arguments, and com.read_ack's one-message form: one message (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments).

message.description: A message of a thread the caller's Project takes part in; an absent and a foreign message answer the same not_authorized.
